_note: What you see: Per screen what exists today in portaliq, learniq and thematiq, what still has to come, and a proposal for the order.
_note_nl: Wat je ziet: Per scherm wat er vandaag is in portaliq, learniq en thematiq, wat er nog moet komen, en een voorstel voor de volgorde.
Per scherm: wat er volgens de analyses v: Per screen: what already exists in portaliq, learniq and thematiq according to the analyses of the Zuiddrecht canvas and the Wilgenboom canvas, and what MBO needs on top. The code was not reviewed again for this canvas. Where those analyses say nothing, it says "still to find out". The MBO-specific work is in the BPV: hours, training companies and assessments per work process.
portaliq, met de gegevens die learniq le: portaliq, with the data that learniq provides
De snede als vast onderdeel onder de kop: The cut as a fixed part below the header and above the footer. A brand stripe per theme is also requested for Zuiddrecht and De Wilgenboom.
Tekst- en nieuwsblokken en de redacteur: Text and news blocks and the editor with a grid exist.
De kaart \"Direct regelen\" en een stapp: The "Arrange directly" card and a steps block. Existing blocks may be enough.
Zoeken met filters is er voor Woo-public: Search with filters exists for Woo publications.
Hetzelfde zoekscherm op opleidingen, met: The same search screen on programmes, with direction, level and pathway. Where the programme catalogue comes from is not known.
Inloggen met DigiD werkt. In het Zuiddre: Signing in with DigiD works. In the Zuiddrecht design eHerkenning sits next to it.
Inloggen met het schoolaccount voor stud: Sign-in with the school account for students. Whether eHerkenning already works and how a workplace supervisor is linked to a training company: still to find out.
Het zijmenu en een overzichtspagina met: The side menu and an overview page with blocks exist.
De kaart \"Vandaag\", de lijst \"Wat je: The "Today" card, the list "What you still need to do" and the week with BPV days and lesson days mixed.
An inbox with messages from school.
Antwoorden, en een bericht waar een taak: Replying, and a message with a task attached, such as returned hours.
Not mentioned in the earlier analyses.
Uren per dag met begin, eind, pauze, oms: Hours per day with start, end, break, description and work process. States: sent, approved, returned.
De stappen van de BPV, de urenstand, de: The steps of the BPV, the hours balance, the self-assessment per work process and the supervisors.
Een eigen omgeving voor het leerbedrijf:: An environment of its own for the training company: only its own students, approve or return with a question, fill in assessment.
In Mijn Zuiddrecht is er een dossier met: In My Zuiddrecht there is a file with documents.
Overeenkomsten met ondertekenstand, resu: Agreements with signing state, results and certificates with an expiry date.
Het menu van learniq en de bovenbalk van: The learniq menu and the Nextcloud top bar. The app menu has counters and a main button.
Een plek voor beeldmerk en app-naam in h: A place for emblem and app name in the menu, and the pink text on the active item. Both are missing according to the Zuiddrecht analysis.
Een dashboard dat de eigen groepen toont: A dashboard that shows your own groups, and the register per lesson.
De kaart \"Vandaag eerst\" zonder gekleu: The "Today first" card without coloured border, and the switch between teacher and BPV supervisor.
learniq heeft een signaal bij 16 uur afw: learniq has a signal at 16 hours of unauthorised absence.
De teller vooraf tonen (\"14 van 16 uur\: Show the counter in advance ("14 of 16 hours"), so a teacher can step in before the report.
Lists and a file with tabs.
De kolommen leerbedrijf en BPV-uren, de: The columns training company and BPV hours, the BPV steps in the header and the "What now?" card.
De gedeelde bibliotheek heeft een bordwe: The shared library has a board view. A late marker is missing there.
Het bord op BPV-fase, met \"te laat\" in: The board by BPV phase, with "late" in words on the card.
Bezoeken per week, uren die wachten per: Visits per week, hours waiting per training company, students per phase. The week strip is a new part.
Resultaten vaststellen per afname, bezwa: Confirming results per sitting, objections with a deadline, exam plans and exemptions. The decision-making may belong in decidiq.
De rij \"Vandaag eerst\" met taken uit a: The "Today first" row with tasks from all apps. That agreement between apps does not exist yet.
De Cunningham-set die Zuiddrecht gebruik: The Cunningham set that Zuiddrecht uses.
Een nieuwe set met pruim en esdoornroze,: A new set with plum and maple pink, derived from the Zuiddrecht set.
Het esdoornblad in kleur en in wit, en h: The maple leaf in colour and in white, and the emblem. The files are ready.
Beide families toevoegen, en een token v: Add both families, and a token for the typeface of codes. Such a token is not mentioned in the earlier analyses.
Dezelfde afleiding voor Esdoornveen, met: The same derivation for Esdoornveen, with the contrast measured again.
Website 4 en 8, werkplek 8 en 12. Of een: Website 4 and 8, workplace 8 and 12. Whether a set can carry two sizes is not known.
De token-set esdoornveen met de logo's,: The token set esdoornveen with the logos, IBM Plex and the dark variant. Existing screens then match straight away.
Uitzoeken wat learniq van de BPV al kent: Find out what learniq already knows about the BPV.
Leerbedrijf, praktijkovereenkomst, uren: Training company, work placement agreement, hours and work processes: half of this canvas depends on that.
Het formulier op de telefoon voor de stu: The form on the phone for the student and the approval screen for the training company, with eHerkenning.
Student en praktijkopleider vullen elk i: Student and workplace supervisor each fill in, the BPV supervisor sees both side by side.
BPV-begeleider eerst, daarna de examenco: BPV supervisor first, then the exam board.
